lines.t: I got needed love, I got needed love
Windy city nights, streetlights painted scars
Pride in my chest, not just baggage in a car
Chased easy thrills and the ones that never stay
Left home ice cold, watched my love fade away
Fists on the table, bottle tipping in my hand
Yelling at the walls, ain't nobody understand
Stand crossroads in my soul, just a man in a fight
Tryna walk or ride in this bitter city night
Whispers from the block, regret a missed call
Heard left behind like names on these walls
Look in the mirror, see the man outgrown
Still hear a voice in the silence calling me home
Seventy times seven, second chances in the rain
Every wrong forgiven even when I fall again
Discipline's heavy but love's holding on
Learning to be a father, learning to belong
Gird up, it's time, got a faith to defend Try to make my love perfect, I won't break
all bend Southside thunder, heart crack wide
Lost my balance, chasing pride Wife packed her bags, took to dreams in keys
Pain hits harder than that lakefront breeze Two kids look at me, need a man to stand
Wasn't ready for the weight, but I'm doing what I can
Grit in the grind, tears in my plea
Every scar story that's making me free
A prayer in the morning, hope in the sound
Fighting for more every time I'm knocked down
Seventy times seven, forgiveness in the blue
Love still here when the old me is through
Total rise up, no more running too high
Learning that discipline, love from the inside
On these Chicago blocks with the wind in chase
Girl, you're my spirit and I give it my best
Turn up my collar, walk it home in a chill
Man enough to break, strong enough to heal
Forgiven, not forgotten, I know where I belong
On these city streets, redemption's my song
